context:
Goal: lanes report to triage, the coordinator and the batch runners without a stop.
Problem (rule): auto mode refused a lane's message to triage at about 14:20 CST. The refusal scan found 2 more. Each refusal stalls a hand-off until a person or another route moves it.
Based on (measured): item 287 scan: 3 send_message refusals among 18 refusals, in about 6,216 judged acts over 359 sessions.
Departs from: main, which has no allow line for send_message — adds an allow line for mcp__claude-code-remote__send_message in lane sessions.
Meanwhile: lanes retry a refused message through their parent.
holds: Whether auto mode checks a lane's messages to other sessions.

lastAnswer.note: yeah allow it, maybe we fix the judge itself for send messages though in genearl i think it's only blocked problematically

options.how: Lane sessions get an allow line for send_message, so auto mode no longer judges each message.
options.label: Allow it
options.lose: A lane could message any session on your account with no check.

options.how: Refusals stay; the lane retries through its parent.
options.label: Keep the check
options.lose: About one stalled hand-off in 2,000 acts.

reply: Your pick a needs a settings.json edit, which cloud sessions cannot make. Item 307 holds the exact prompt to paste into a Mac session. Your judge idea is roadmap step judge-send-message-refusals. Closes when the allow line merges.
title: Should lane sessions be allowed to message other sessions without an auto-mode check?
why: A refused hand-off message stalls the lane's work until someone moves it.
